package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type Get struct {
	Requests repository.CoursePlanRepository
}

func (useCase Get) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, requestID string) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	requestID = strings.TrimSpace(requestID)
	_, studentError := uuid.Parse(studentID)
	_, requestError := uuid.Parse(requestID)
	if useCase.Requests == nil || studentError != nil || requestError != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Requests.GetForStudent(ctx, studentID, requestID)
}
